articles.summary: Nestled amidst the lava rock, natural ponds and thick vegetation on the Island of Hawaii's renowned Kona Coast, the iconic Kona Village was lovingly reimagined by Kennedy Wilson following an 11-year closure and has reopened as a Rosewood Resort. Kennedy Wilson acquired the iconic resort in 2016 and led a substantial redevelopment process that prioritized sustainability, respect for local culture, state-of-the-art technology, and authentic design.
articles.title: Kona Village
